objective: T-20260929-70: does net share issuance NSI252 = ln(shares_t / shares_{t-252}) (low issuance is long) predict the cross-section of returns in the ADV top-1500 pool (price >= 5) after next-open entry, in the 2024+ window and the full 2017-2026 sample, and is it distinct from size and 12-1 momentum? Only if the cheap IC test passes are 8 preregistered long-only / long-short books screened at 10/20 bp with borrow.
target_regime_and_horizon: US common stocks, cross-sectional 20 and 60 session horizons, monthly or quarterly rebalance; recent window 2024-01-01 onward, full sample 2017-2026. Validity is not assumed for any regime: a pass would be labeled recent-window evidence with the stress sample starting 2017 only.
existing_solution_comparison: Published: Pontiff-Woodgate (JF 2008), Fama-French 2008 (both known only via secondary summaries, claim_only; QuantDecoded blocked on 2026-09-29). Newest opened source: QuanterLab 2026-08-19 (snapshot in sources/), S&P 500 30 lowest-share-growth long-only 2006-2025 at 10 bp: 10.58%/yr, Sharpe 0.58 vs index 0.54, a statistical tie (35 of 100 bootstrap paths). Existing products: quality/net-buyback ETFs (PKW, SPYD-like buyback screens) hold large caps long-only; none reports a 2024+ short leg. Why not enough: it tests a large-cap long-only annual book, not the broad top-1500 cross-section, the short leg with borrow, or the 2024+ window. Local repo never computed a share-count-change signal: dir:sec_xbrl_accounting_signals_v1 tested ROE, gross profitability, asset growth (2024+ IC -0.006 at 20d, flags failed) and accruals only.
remaining_evidence_gap: Pontiff-Woodgate and Fama-French numbers were not read in primary text (only a blocked secondary summary), so no effect size from them is used as a target. Cover-page shares are not split adjusted and double-class firms may report one class, so the signal is cleaned by frozen rules and its measurement error is a risk the IC test absorbs. No dollar buyback amounts locally: the repurchase-dollar version is not tested.
negative_experiments_checked: oc research directions check net share issuance buyback (2026-09-29): dir:net_share_issuance_pontiff_woodgate_recent queued (this task); dir:buyback_announcement_effect and dir:buyback_execution_vs_announcement both evidence_too_weak, never computed locally; dir:sec_xbrl_accounting_signals_v1 asset growth card (reports/research/signal-cards/asset_growth.md) is the nearest accounting anomaly and failed the predictive flag. grep of reports/research/control, iterations and ledger for share count or issuance found no local test of share-count change.
cost_and_execution_assumptions: Signal known at the close of trade_date, entry at the next open; 10 bp per side (20 bp check); short leg only among ADV top-500 (easy-to-borrow proxy) with borrow 0.5%/yr and 3%/yr sensitivity tiers and a 252-day SPY beta hedge; monthly (21 offsets) or quarterly (every third of 63 offsets) rebalance, median across offsets decides. Prices pass sanitize_price_matrices defaults. Stress period 2017-2023 is short (data from 2016).
stop_condition: Stage 1 (IC, signal_card rank mode, ADV top 1500, horizons 20 and 60): continue only if at one horizon ALL hold: 2024+ mean RankIC has the preregistered sign (low issuance -> high return, i.e. direction -1 IC positive after the sign flip in the card) with Newey-West |t| >= 2.0; full-sample IC has the same sign; distinct_from_controls flag true; IC of NSI residualized on log dollar ADV and 12-1 momentum keeps >= 50% of the raw 2024+ IC. Otherwise stop, registry row refuted, no ledger. Stage 2 verdicts use the runbook K1/K2/watch_recent tiers unchanged. No threshold, sign, horizon or candidate changes after results.

queries.query: net share issuance factor 2023 2024 2025 performance recent years Sharpe

sources.claim: QuanterLab 2026-08-19 (author-run, S&P 500 point-in-time, 20 sealed windows 2006-2025, net of costs): the low-net-issuance book earns 10.58%/yr, Sharpe 0.58, versus the reference index 9.51%/yr, Sharpe 0.54, and beats the earnings-yield book in only 35 of 100 bootstrap paths, which the author calls a statistical tie.
sources.market_and_period: S&P 500 point-in-time constituents, 2006-2025, 20 sealed windows, 10 bp
sources.applicability: Only recent published test of a net-issuance long book: a tie with the index, so the plain long-only large-cap version adds nothing; the local question is the cross-section in a broad top-1500 pool since 2024 and the short leg.
sources.limitations: Author-run platform study of a 30-name low-share-growth long-only S&P 500 book with annual reselection; no borrow or short leg, no 2024+ split, cover-page share counts are not used (weighted shares from filings); second source QuantDecoded (Pontiff-Woodgate 2008 summary) was blocked by a Vercel checkpoint on 2026-09-29 (HTTP 429), so it is claim_only and no number from it is used.

cheapest_decisive_test.action: Build NSI252/NSI126 with frozen cleaning rules (scripts/build_nsi_signal.py), run signal_card rank mode (ADV top 1500, direction -1, primary horizon 20 and 60) and a residual/Newey-West companion (scripts/nsi_ic_test.py); no book before this passes.
cheapest_decisive_test.pass_condition: At 20d or 60d: 2024+ RankIC sign as preregistered with Newey-West |t| >= 2.0, full-sample same sign, distinct_from_controls true, residual IC >= 50% of raw.
cheapest_decisive_test.falsification_condition: Any of the four conditions fails at both horizons.
